subject.title: [Bug] Race condition in approval-classifier.ts when tokenization exceeds max tokens

question: Can an ACP server or current OpenClaw call path execute or accept a risky tool payload before the requestPermission promise returned by the client settles?
rationale: The public report alleges a security-boundary bypass but does not identify a current asynchronous tokenizer or reproducible protocol sequence, so an ACP/security owner must validate the actual boundary before disclosure, repair, or closure.

options.title: Validate the protocol boundary
options.body: Run a focused delayed-permission harness and close the issue if no tool execution or payload acceptance occurs before resolution.

options.title: Request a private reproducer
options.body: Ask the reporter to provide the exact ACP server, payload sequence, token-limit configuration, and timestamps through a private security channel.

options.title: Escalate to a private advisory
options.body: If the bypass reproduces, transfer technical details to a GitHub Security Advisory and coordinate a tested fix before further public discussion.
